description: opensource project for conversions between Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese and Japanese Kanji (Shinjitai). Its 1.2.0 STPhrases, STCharacters and TWVariants, unchanged, are compiled into the app's simplified-to-traditional data (the same output as OpenCC's s2tw); its character tables TSCharacters.txt and STCharacters.txt (1.2.0, unchanged) ship in the app's assets under learn/, for learning to read traditional text as simplified.
name: BYVoid/OpenCC
